label: training-gym-r36-complete
context:
Training Gym R36 completed. All 4 exercises 10/10 (1 required bug fix in AVL).

R36 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. avl-001 (T7) - AVL Tree with insert/delete/rebalancing. 6 tests. Bug: recursive successor delete counted as extra deletion. Fixed with dummy flag.
2. suffix-array-001 (T7) - Suffix Array with doubling algorithm, LCP via Kasai, binary search pattern matching. 6 tests.
3. lfu-001 (T7) - LFU Cache O(1) get/put with freq_map+OrderedDict. 6 tests.
4. sliding-window-001 (T6) - Monotonic deque for max/min, prefix sum, variable window two-pointer. 7 tests.

KEY PATTERNS:
- AVL delete successor: use dummy [False] list to avoid double-counting size
- Suffix Array doubling: sort by (rank[i], rank[i+k]) pairs, double k each iteration
- LFU: freq_map[freq]=OrderedDict of keys, min_freq tracks eviction target, popitem(last=False) for LRU tie-break
- Monotonic deque: maintain indices in decreasing (max) or increasing (min) order of values

DB: 218 exercises, 383 attempts, avg 9.86
decisions: AVL delete: use dummy found flag for successor deletion to avoid size double-count
LFU min_freq: only increment when freq_map[min_freq] becomes empty
Suffix array search: binary search for leftmost, then scan right for all matches
Monotonic deque: remove from front if out of window, from back if dominated
next_steps: Design R37 exercises. Continue with: Disjoint Set with path splitting, Bloom Filter counting, KMP string matching, or Top-K Frequent.
